Dear Team,

Thank you for confirming receipt and registering the ticket.

Please note that the refund timeline of 14 working days was already confirmed by your team on March 10, and this period has now passed without the refund being processed.

Accordingly, this case is already overdue, and we do not accept a restart of the refund timeline.

All required bank details have been provided to Your team.
We kindly request you to proceed with the transfer immediately and confirm once the payment has been initiated.

We look forward to your prompt confirmation.Best regards,M KOn 2 Apr 2026, at 18:06, fäm Living - Deposit refund <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:﻿Dear Mikhail Kantsavenka,This confirms that we received your email and registered it as ticket #939395166. You can always reply to this email to add additional information. Meanwhile, please note the following:If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days. If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.The refund will be processed in full through your preferred mode of payment, subject to a property inspection.To ensure a prompt refund, we kindly request you provide your preferred mode of refund (credit card, local bank account, cash, or international wire) to your dedicated guest relations executive as soon as possible. This will facilitate the timely return of funds to our valued guests.Below are the necessary fields and information required for a swift refund by bank transfer:Booking reference number:Beneficiary Name: Beneficiary Address:Beneficiary Bank Name:Beneficiary Bank Account Details (IBAN):Swift Code: Beneficiary Bank Address:Currency of Account:Sort Code:Kinds regards,Team fäm Living
